events.description: Physical struggle involving multiple individuals; visible grabbing, pulling, and forceful contact between people.
A handgun is visibly raised and pointed by a man in frame f12 (5.5s); though no muzzle flash or bullet is seen, the posture and context strongly indicate an imminent or occurring shooting event.
One individual (woman with dark hair) appears restrained and overwhelmed during the physical struggle, consistent with being attacked while unable to effectively resist.

Three individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat: a woman and a bald man grapple while a third man (Tom Cruise) intervenes, striking the bald man; motion blur indicates rapid movement and impact.
The fight continues with Tom Cruise delivering repeated strikes to the bald man, who is visibly reacting with pain and shouting; the woman remains involved in the struggle.
A new phase of the fight begins as another man (in grey suit) joins, grappling with Tom Cruise; the bald man is momentarily subdued but re-engages; chaotic multi-person melee ensues.
A multi-person physical struggle occurs in a kitchen: two men grapple while a woman is restrained and screams; one man is thrown onto a counter and another is taken down.
A woman is physically restrained by a man, her mouth covered, and she is visibly distressed and screaming—indicating non-consensual control and harm.

Continued combat: a man in a suit tackles another man, who falls to the floor; a third man is seen being choked from behind; the struggle ends with one man on the ground and another recovering near the counter.
A bright muzzle flash is visible in frame f6 (55.0s), indicating a firearm discharge from the perspective of the shooter; the flash illuminates the room and is consistent with a gunshot.

Frames f0–f2 show a person in dark clothing lunging or grappling with another individual near stacked boxes, with motion blur suggesting rapid physical contact; this appears to be mutual physical combat.
Frames f4–f5 depict a person in dark clothing moving aggressively toward the floor/another person with outstretched arm, consistent with an ongoing physical struggle or takedown.
A man in a dark suit fires a handgun, with a bright muzzle flash visible at the barrel.
A man enters a room and engages in close-quarters physical struggle with another person who is on the floor; motion blur indicates rapid movement and contact.
After being shot, a person is seen falling and being struck or subdued on the ground in a darkened area, with visible body contortions and impact motion.
Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat: one initiates a strike, they grapple, and one is thrown to the ground.
A man stands over another man lying on the floor, appearing to subdue or assault him while he is incapacitated.

A woman holds a handgun pointed forward; a man behind her also holds a firearm (appears to be a submachine gun or pistol) aimed down a hallway. No muzzle flash or bullet impact is visible, but both are actively aiming weapons in a confrontational stance.
